# Super Molar

> > Super Molar is a multi-location pediatric dentistry practice across Long Island and Nassau County, NY, offering comprehensive children's dental care, orthodontics, and family dentistry services.

Super Molar operates four office locations (Medford, Smithtown, Islip, and Garden City) and specializes in pediatric dentistry and orthodontic services for children. The practice provides patient education, orthodontic FAQs, and detailed office information to serve families across Suffolk and Nassau counties.
